article.headline: Duke visits No. 5 Miami (FL) in ACC matchup
article.description: Duke (7-2) at No. 5 Miami (FL) (8-1), Nov. 14 at 12 p.m. EST.
article.title: Duke visits No. 5 Miami (FL) in ACC matchup
article.linkText: Duke visits No. 5 Miami (FL) in ACC matchup
article.story: Duke (7-2) at No. 5 Miami (FL) (8-1), Nov. 14 at 12 p.m. EST. Opening Line: Miami (FL) by 14.5. Against the spread: Miami (FL) 5-3-1, Duke 7-2. How to watch: ABC Key stats Miami (FL) Offense Overall: 517.3 yards per game (3rd in FBS) Passing: 326.1 yards per game (4th) Rushing: 191.2 yards per game (30th) Scoring: 45.0 points per game (1st) Miami (FL) Defense Overall: 323.7 yards per game (33rd in FBS) Passing: 259.3 yards per game (127th) Rushing: 64.3 yards per game (1st) Scoring: 19.2 points per game (23rd) Duke Offense Overall: 425.1 yards per game (33rd in FBS) Passing: 234.6 yards per game (62nd) Rushing: 190.6 yards per game (31st) Scoring: 33.0 points per game (35th) Duke Defense Overall: 282.1 yards per game (11th in FBS) Passing: 186.6 yards per game (29th) Rushing: 95.6 yards per game (12th) Scoring: 13.0 points per game (5th) Miami (FL) ranks 5th in FBS in third down percentage, converting 52.9% of the time. Duke is 116th in the FBS with 68.3 penalty yards per game. Miami (FL) is 23rd in FBS in red zone offense, scoring on 91.5% of trips. Both teams rank high in time of possession. Miami (FL) is 7th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 33:09, while Duke's 20th-ranked average is 32:19. Team leaders Miami (FL) Passing: Darian Mensah, 2,701 yards, 28 TDs, 2 INTs, 76.8 completion percentage Rushing: Mark Fletcher, 514 yards on 107 carries, 9 TDs Receiving: Malachi Toney, 1,027 yards on 73 catches, 13 TDs Duke Passing: Walker Eget, 1,849 yards, 10 TDs, 3 INTs, 63.0 completion percentage Rushing: Nate Sheppard, 1,189 yards on 191 carries, 17 TDs Receiving: Jonah Burton, 351 yards on 26 catches, 1 TD Last game Miami (FL) lost 31-24 to Notre Dame on Nov. 7. Mensah passed for 276 yards on 24-of-43 attempts (55.8%) with three touchdowns and one interception. He also carried the ball 11 times for 28 yards. Fletcher carried the ball 13 times for 57 yards, adding one reception for six yards. Elija Lofton had seven receptions for 113 yards and one touchdown. Duke beat NC State 41-3 on Nov. 7. Eget led Duke with 208 yards on 22-of-31 passing (71.0%) for one touchdown and no interceptions. Sheppard had 217 rushing yards on 18 carries and three touchdowns, adding one reception for four yards. Jaivon Solomon recorded 71 yards on five catches with one touchdown. Next game Miami (FL) hosts Virginia Tech on Nov. 21. Duke hosts Clemson on Nov. 20.
